title: Use vscreen_launch to op

messages.content: Use vscreen_launch to open com.android.settings, read it with vscreen_screen, tap the first list item, then vscreen_close. Report each step briefly. TASKX2

messages.reasoning: I need to enable the extended tools group first since vscreen_launch and related tools are part of that category. There's also a note about accessibility services being disabled on the Meizu system, which could potentially block these operations, but I'll proceed with enabling the tools and see what happens.
